hypothesis: The M170/M171 replay failures may be caused by tiny action or hidden-state shifts on low-margin rows, so fragile-row action and margin sensitivity should be audited before changing PPO or objectives.
success_criteria: compare row 67 across M168 and M170
compare rows 70 and 77 across M168 and M171
measure first-action deltas, wrong-history action deltas, margin flips, and terminal reason changes
decide whether a fragile-row action anchor or replay-aligned objective is justified
do not run another PPO stage during this audit
failure_criteria: run more PPO before explaining the lost fragile rows
assume fixed objective improvement implies replay safety
treat row67 as the only fragile row

commands.name: m173_fragile_row_action_margin_sensitivity_audit
commands.command: Inspect boundary replay rows for M168/M170/M171 and quantify action and margin sensitivity on rows 67, 70, and 77.

decision_rule: Only after the audit identifies the sensitivity mechanism should the project add a new objective or try another PPO stage.
